# proxmox_sdn_vnet_firewall_options (Resource)

Manages the firewall options of one Proxmox VE SDN VNet through `/cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/firewall/options`. Firewall options are not staged: they apply immediately and are independent of `proxmox_sdn_apply`. Requires `SDN.Allocate` on the VNet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# VNet firewall options apply immediately, unlike the staged SDN objects.
# Credentials need SDN.Allocate on the VNet.
resource "proxmox_sdn_vnet_firewall_options" "app" {
  vnet              = proxmox_sdn_vnet.app.vnet
  enable            = true
  policy_forward    = "DROP"
  log_level_forward = "info"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) VNet the options belong to. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `enable` (Boolean) Enable the firewall for this VNet.
- `log_level_forward` (String) Log level for forwarded traffic, for example `info` or `nolog`.
- `policy_forward` (String) Forward policy: `ACCEPT` or `DROP`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VNet identifier (same as `vnet`).
